Complete Guide to Home Coffee Brewing

By Maria Lopez

Brewing coffee at home is easier than most people think. This guide explains the equipment, grind sizes and timings you need to make a consistently good cup.

What you need

  • Fresh whole beans
  • A burr grinder
  • A scale

Grinders

A burr grinder produces even particles. Read our grinder comparison for details.

Brewing steps

  1. Heat water to 93 degrees Celsius.
  2. Grind and weigh the coffee.
  3. Pour in stages and wait for the bloom.

Sources

Temperature guidance follows the Specialty Coffee Association and Wikipedia. Jump to the steps.
